source: FIGURES.md adapted for a single-festival guide, 2026-09-25, as for Burning Man, Tomorrowland and EDC Las Vegas. History: Wikipedia, 'Awakenings (festival)' (founding 30 March 1997, name origin, 2000/2005 venue moves, 2006 police raids, 2014 foreign expansion, 2015 SFX/LiveStyle acquisition, 2020 online edition). Current venue and dates: awakenings.com itself (live, 2026-09-25: 'AWAKENINGS FESTIVAL 2027 JULY 9-11', 'AWAKENINGS ADE 2026 OCT 21-25', 'How to travel to Awakenings Festival 2026' page naming Beekse Bergen, Hilvarenbeek). 2026 sellout and 'largest edition' claim: Nuémoro Netherlands, 'Awakenings Festival 2026 Sells Out Ahead Of...' (4 June 2026). DJ Mag 2026 rank (34th, down 14): djmag.com Top 100 Festivals 2026 live-results page and DJ Mag Germany's results article, both dated 2 July 2026 (djmag.com itself returned a Cloudflare 520 error when checked directly, so the ranking is sourced from Google's indexed results and DJ Mag Germany's mirror of the same list, not the live page). Wikimedia Commons Category:Awakenings (festival) for the image; selector-data.json searched for 'awakenings' for the video.
